name: Doki Doki Forever & Ever
summary: Have you wondered what it would be like if President Sayori was the one sitting in front of you? This mod takes place in the memorable classroom of the 3rd Act of DDLC, but with everyone's favourite girl next-door. The traditional storytelling gameplay is swapped out with extended interactions meant to give Sayori a lot more depth. Speak about a variety of interesting topics with Sayori, for as long as you'd like. After all, she's going to be there forever, and ever.
